headline: Intuit Posts Weak Outlook, Stoking Broad Concerns Across Legacy Software
summary: TurboTax maker Intuit issued a downbeat forecast, deepening Wall Street anxieties regarding growth trends among legacy software providers.
why: Intuit is a major financial and business management software vendor whose forecasts serve as an indicator for enterprise and consumer software demand.

impacts.name: Intuit
impacts.why: Intuit issued a downbeat financial outlook that triggered investor selling.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Intuit shares and software sector sentiment fell after the company released a lower-than-expected outlook.
